# ScriptFactory

*Common*

Creates script values, available as the global `scram`: vectors, texts, item stacks, NBT, forms and transforms, script UIs, textures, camera shakes and packet handlers.

## Methods

### text {#text}

::: member

Creates an empty styled chat text; fill it with `append(...)`.

**Returns** [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) — new empty text.

:::

### text {#text-2}

::: member

Creates a styled chat text, shown with `send(...)` of a player, the server or the context.

```js
c.getPlayer().send(scram.text("Welcome!").color("gold").bold(true));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | initial content. |

**Returns** [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) — new text.

:::

### vector {#vector}

::: member

```js
var up = scram.vector(0, 1, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x component |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y component |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z component |

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector

:::

### random {#random}

::: member

Picks a random whole number from 0 to `max`, both included. The ends are half as likely as the other numbers; use `Math.floor(Math.random() * n)` for an even choice of 0 to n - 1.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest number |

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — random number

:::

### form {#form}

::: member

Creates a form from BBS data, as the "Paste form" action of the script editor writes it or `form.toData()`

gives it.

```js
var label = scram.form('{id:"bbs:label"}').setText("Hello");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formData` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS data of the form |

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — the form

:::

### transform {#transform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) — a transform with no offset, no rotation and the original size

:::

### transform {#transform-2}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transformData` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS data of a transform, as `transform.toString()` gives it |

**Returns** [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) — the transform

:::

### states {#states}

::: member

**Returns** `States` — new empty states, not saved anywhere; for values that only live while the script runs

:::

### ui {#ui}

::: member

Starts a script screen; add components to the builder, then show it with `c.getPlayer().openUI(ui)`. Only for client scripts.

```js
var ui = scram.ui();

ui.label("Hello").rxy(0.5, 0.5).anchor(0.5);
c.getPlayer().openUI(ui);
```

**Returns** [`ScramUIBuilder`](/scripting/client/ui/ScramUIBuilder) — new empty screen builder

:::

### texture {#texture}

::: member

Loads a texture for script UIs and rendering.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `textureId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | texture link: `source:path`, e.g. `minecraft:textures/block/stone.png`; without a source it is a BBS asset (`assets:`). |

**Returns** [`ScramClientTexture`](/scripting/client/scram/ScramClientTexture) — the texture; a missing file shows the missing texture.

:::

### shake {#shake}

::: member

Creates a camera shake; set it up with its methods and play it with the client camera. Only for client scripts.

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — new shake with default settings

:::

### block {#block}

::: member

Creates the default state of a block.

```js
c.getWorld().setBlock(scram.block("minecraft:dirt"), 0, 64, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blockId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, like `"minecraft:dirt"`; properties in brackets are not supported, set them with `setProperty` |

**Returns** [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) — the block state; air if the block is unknown

:::

### compound {#compound}

::: member

Creates an NBT compound from text in the SNBT style: typed numbers like `1b`, `2.5f` and

`10L`, strings in double quotes, lists and nested compounds; typed arrays like `[I;1,2]` are not supported.

```js
var data = scram.compound('{Health: 50.0f, Tags: ["boss"]}');
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbt` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | compound text, or null for an empty compound |

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — new compound

:::

### registerServerPacket {#registerserverpacket}

::: member

Registers a server handler of the packets a client script sends with `c.sendPacket(id, buffer)`. A handler registered again under the same id replaces the previous one.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverPacketId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | packet id, 1 to 64 characters; the editor suggests the ids registered so far. |
| `handler` | `Function<ScriptServerContext,ScramBuffer>` | handler called with the context of the sending player and the packet data. |

:::

### registerClientPacket {#registerclientpacket}

::: member

Registers a client handler of the packets a server script sends with `player.sendPacket(id, buffer)`. A handler registered again under the same id replaces the previous one.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clientPacketId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | packet id, 1 to 64 characters; the editor suggests the ids registered so far. |
| `handler` | `Function<ScriptClientContext,ScramBuffer>` | handler called with the client context and the packet data. |

:::

### buffer {#buffer}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScramBuffer`](/scripting/common/ScramBuffer) — empty buffer for script packets.

:::

### buffer {#buffer-2}

::: member

Creates a buffer from a copy of an NBT compound converted to BBS data. Later changes to the compound do not affect the buffer.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compound` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | initial buffer values. |

**Returns** [`ScramBuffer`](/scripting/common/ScramBuffer) — buffer for script packets.

:::

### dump {#dump}

::: member

Describes a Java object for debugging: its fields with their values, then its methods.

```js
c.send(scram.dump(c.getPlayer(), true));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | `Any` | object to describe, not null |
| `simple` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether to show short type names without modifiers |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — multi-line description

:::

### getClassName {#getclassname}

::: member

```js
c.send(scram.getClassName(c.getPlayer())); // ScriptServerPlayer
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Any` | Java object, not null |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — simple name of the object's Java class

:::

### item {#item}

::: member

Creates one item.

```js
c.getPlayer().giveItem(scram.item("minecraft:diamond_sword"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | item ID, like `"minecraft:stone"` |

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — new stack of one item

:::

### item {#item-2}

::: member

Creates a stack of items.

```js
c.getPlayer().giveItem(scram.item("minecraft:apple", 16));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | item ID, like `"minecraft:stone"` |
| `count` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | number of items; more than the item's stack size is allowed |

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — new stack

:::

### itemFromNbt {#itemfromnbt}

::: member

Creates an item stack from its NBT data, as `ScriptItemStack.serialize()` returns it. It has its own name because `item(null)` would match both the ID and the NBT variant.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | NBT with `id`, `Count` and optional `tag`; null gives an empty stack |

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — the stack, empty if the data is null or has no known item

:::

### nbtList {#nbtlist}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) — a new empty NBT list

:::

### nbtList {#nbtlist-2}

::: member

Creates an NBT list from text in the same style as [`compound(String)`](#compound).

```js
var list = scram.nbtList('["first", "second"]');
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | list text, like `"[1, 2, 3]"` |

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) — new list

:::

### style {#style}

::: member

Turns formatting codes into text style prefixes for chat, titles and names.

```js
c.send(scram.style("6l") + "Gold and bold");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `codes` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | formatting code characters: 0-9 and a-f are colors, l bold, o italic, n underline, m strikethrough, k obfuscated, r reset |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the codes, each after a section sign

:::

### uuid {#uuid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — a new random UUID string, unique for practical purposes

:::
